title: Kyber don raise $5M to build di real-time infrastructure layer for physical AI
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
Paris / San Francisco, June 10, 2026. Kyber don comot from hiding with $5 million seed money. Lightspeed Venture Partners lead di round, and Ovni Capital and Kima Ventures join hand. Na Jean-Baptiste Kempf, di engineer wey dey behind VLC Media Player and FFmpeg, start Kyber. Di company dey build open-source real-time infrastructure wey dey connect human beings and AI agents to robots, drones and machines wey dey run by demsef, from anywhere for di world, almost without any delay.

Di layer wey eye no dey see, wey physical AI don dey miss

Some kain technology dey wey most pipo no dey even think about. E no get interface. E just dey run quietly, until di day wey e go become so important say di world no fit function without am again.

Jean-Baptiste Kempf don spend twenty years dey build exactly dat kain technology. First na VLC, di media player wey dey quietly sidon inside four billion devices. After dat na FFmpeg, di codec library wey dey run inside almost every video platform for dis world. Both of dem don become important pieces of di internet infrastructure wey eye no dey see.

Na di same belief dem take build Kyber, but dis time e dey face new ground: di physical world.

As AI dey comot from screen dey enter robots, drones, surgery machines and motor wey dey drive demsef, one wahala don dey everywhere: real-time interaction. Robot no fit afford to dey buffer. Drone no fit dey lag. Machine wey pipo dey control from far suppose dey respond sharp-sharp, like say e dey right for your front.

Until now, di infrastructure wey fit make am possible just no dey.

Why latency na serious wahala, and how Kyber dey solve am

Most real-time systems wey dey today, na on top WebRTC dem build dem, and WebRTC na protocol wey dem design for video call. If delay reach 200 milliseconds, motor wey person dey control from far don already pass di place wey di operator wan make am stop by plenty meters. For 8 milliseconds, wey na wetin Kyber dey make possible, di machine go feel like say na di operator own hand directly.

Kyber dey give one single SDK wey dey sync everything wey real-time machine control need:

  • Video, audio, sensor data and control inputs, all of dem dey follow one single clock
  • End-to-end latency wey low reach 8 milliseconds, wey human being no fit even notice
  • E open from di root, and you fit deploy am on-premise, for cloud, or mix di two

Dem design am for robotics, XR, drones, motor wey dey drive demsef, AI agents, remote desktop, and di next generation of physical AI applications.

Kyber don already dey work commercially with top players for defense, telco, robotics and AI. Di company get team of 26 specialist engineers wey come from robotics, networking, low-latency computing and video infrastructure.

Di investors wey dey back Kyber vision

Na Lightspeed Venture Partners, one of di biggest venture firms for di whole world, lead di $5M seed round, and Ovni Capital and Kima Ventures join dem.

“As we dey invest for AI and robotics, we just dey see di same pattern: di models dey get sense pass before, but di infrastructure wey dey connect dem to di physical world no dey catch up. Na im make us dig down di stack go ask wetin really dey miss. Kyber na one of di strongest answer wey we see for dat problem.” Antoine Moyroud, Partner for Lightspeed Venture Partners

Wetin dey come next

Di money go help Kyber move faster to develop di protocol layer wey dey connect human beings and AI agents to machines for real time, across every industry wey autonomous systems don dey become very important.

As Jean-Baptiste Kempf talk am:

“For di next few years, plenty autonomous machines go dey waka up and down, and Kyber go produce di key software wey pipo go take build, control and monitor dose machines for real time.”

Physical AI dey move fast. Di machines dey get more sense. Now, di infrastructure must catch up.

Find out more for kyber.tech

Who be Kyber

Na Jean-Baptiste Kempf, di engineer wey dey behind VLC and FFmpeg, start Kyber for Paris. Kyber dey build di open-source real-time infrastructure layer for physical AI. Lightspeed Venture Partners, Ovni Capital and Kima Ventures dey back am.

Who be Lightspeed Venture Partners

Lightspeed na global venture capital firm wey dey invest for different stages, and e dey manage assets wey pass $50B. Since 2000, Lightspeed don back some of di most innovative companies for di world like Anthropic, Mistral, Snap, Wiz and oda ones.

Website: lightspeedhq.com

Who be Ovni Capital

Ovni Capital na French venture capital firm wey dey back entrepreneurs wey dey build di next generation of strategic technologies, from deep tech reach infrastructure.

Website: ovni.capital

Who be Kima Ventures

Na Xavier Niel start Kima Ventures, and e be one of di seed investors wey dey most active for Europe. E dey back technology founders wey get big dream from di very early stage.

Website: https://www.kimaventures.com

Who be Les Echos

Les Echos na di number one business and finance daily newspaper for France, wey dey cover di latest news for economy, technology and innovation.

Website: lesechos.fr
